environment: Node v24.18.0 wasm SIMD on Mac Studio (M1 Max); load average 12-14; browser/device performance remains separate
method: A measurement build of each source with performance.now() spans around the Session stages (not committed: the spans only time, the pixels are the same). The bench scene at 1280x960 (color-review-wasm-bench.cjs), the same settings (exposure 0.2, highlights -75, shadows 55, blacks 40, vibrance 10, HSL), a contrast drag and its release, then 5 Interactive ticks of relativeTemperature 6..30 and their release (Final). Median of 3 processes.

stages.balance: the head white balance of the whole working source
stages.features: niho-6 features of the balanced whole photo
stages.gains: niho-6 response gains at the frame size
stages.cubes: settings_cubes (baking the Final 64^3 cubes when not kept)
stages.stats: adaptive statistics of the local pass
stages.rest: the frame itself (per-pixel stages and output) and everything not spanned
